audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Timewinder a stun — whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0], the early paragraph and wants.foe[0] all build advice on "Timewinder stuns".
audit.why: Timewinder slows and damages on the way out and again on the return; it has no stun. Ekko's only stun is Parallel Convergence, and it stuns ONLY if Ekko himself enters the anomaly he placed — the tell is his feet, not the cast. Phase Dive is a 325-range blink carried on an auto-attack reset, and Chronobreak is 110/80/50s, makes him untargetable and heals him for a share of damage taken.
audit.corrected: Every Timewinder-stun claim replaced with the real mechanic; the anomaly entry condition, the 325 blink range, the auto-reset tell and the 110s ult are now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full and content layers disagree on rows 3-6 (full: Skill/Ekko/Skill/Skill; content: Ekko/Anivia/Ekko/Anivia), and the packet flags the chart as contradicting the data — Anivia wins 54.45% over 865 games while the chart hands Ekko 5 of 7 rows.
audit.why: Ekko genuinely owns levels 1-5: Phase Dive plus the anomaly stun beats an immobile Anivia. But by first item Anivia's mana core makes Glacial Storm permanent while Ekko's burst window stays short and gated behind a 110-second ult, which is what the win rate reflects.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Ekko/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia across both layers — phases[3..6].side plus the paired win[5] flip. That removes the layer disagreement and the win-rate contradiction in one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] (1st item) and whys[5] both credited Ekko with owning the first-item stage on the strength of "Chronobreak's reset safety net".
audit.why: Chronobreak is once per fight on a 110s rank-1 cooldown; Anivia's first-item spike is a mana item that lets Glacial Storm stay up permanently. Both texts had to move with the chart row.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[2] rewritten around Seraph's uptime versus his one-shot window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions Grievous Wounds despite Chronobreak healing a percentage of damage received.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags it directly: anti-heal timing decides whether your burst actually finishes him.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and the mid paragraph now name anti-heal before the commit.

edits.before: Ekko's Timewinder is a genuine skillshot threat that stuns on the return, and his W lets him dive in for burst you simply can't out-trade at levels 1-2. Any Q whiff from you gets punished hard since he has both mobility and burst to capitalize instantly. Play max-range farming, respect his stun windows, and don't contest waves — his all-in potential from level 3 onward is severe and you have no reliable counter-engage yet.
edits.after: Ekko's Timewinder is a genuine skillshot threat that slows on the way out and again on the return, and Parallel Convergence only stuns when he walks into his own anomaly — so watch his feet, not the cast. Any Q whiff gets punished since he has both mobility and burst to capitalize instantly. Farm at max range and don't contest waves — his all-in from level 3 onward is severe and you have no counter-engage yet.

edits.before: Ekko continues to dominate trades through levels 4-5 with his stun-into-burst combo, and once he hits 6 his Chronobreak reset means an all-in gone wrong for him often isn't actually punished — he rewinds and escapes or resets the fight in his favor. Your Glacial Storm at 6 gives you real zone pressure for the first time, but his damage burst and reset safety net still outweigh it in a straight fight. Play for poke and wave control rather than forcing exchanges.
edits.after: Ekko dominates trades through levels 4-5 with Phase Dive's 325-range blink into the auto-attack reset, and at 6 Chronobreak means an all-in gone wrong for him often isn't punished — he goes untargetable, rewinds and heals. Your Glacial Storm at 6 gives real zone pressure for the first time, and at rank 1 his ult is 110 seconds, so the fight after he spends it belongs to you. Buy anti-heal before you try to burst him down.
